keyPoints: Paryavaran me jeev (paudhe, janwar, sukshm jeev) aur nirjeev (hawa, paani, mitti, roshni) dono aate hain — sab milkar paristhitik tantra banate hain.
Bhojan shringkhala me har star par urja ka lagbhag 90% nasht ho jaata hai aur sirf 10% aage jaata hai — ise 10% niyam kehte hain, isiliye shakahari bhojan me zyada urja milti hai.
Apghatak (decomposer) mare jeevon aur kachre ko sadakar poshak tatva wapas mitti me lautaate hain; inke bina poshak chakra ruk jayega.
Jaiv aavardhan (biomagnification) me hanikarak rasayan (jaise keetnashak) shringkhala me upar jaate-jaate badhte jaate hain aur sheersh upbhokta ko sabse zyada nuksan pahunchate hain.
Ozone parat ki kshati, jalvayu parivartan aur kachra prabandhan aaj ki sabse badi paryavaran chunautiyan hain.
Jaiv nimnikaraniya (biodegradable) kachra — sabzi ke chhilke, kagaz — sad jaata hai, jabki ajaiv kachra — plastic, kaanch — hazaaron saal pada rehta hai.
Aam galti: kachra phenkne ko chhoti baat samajhna; nali me phenki plastic ki thaili nadi-samudra tak pahunchkar machhliyon aur kachhuon ki jaan le leti hai.
